title: [P2] Incorrect original artifact checksum is certified as matching
detail: Evidence: claimed a4eafbd7365b98df3637e19195d2c00346a0c0ad5d40c74f514d7c17758ea093; actual SHA256(docs/arch-improvement/cycle-7/evidence/protocol-package/dist/index.js) = a4eafbd7365b261f6645442a4646b5c01fc9192ce056f8f479087b7e0573578f. Impact: copied artifact bytes are preserved but provenance assertion is false. Rule: AP-026/AP-076. Fix decision: original curator bounded remediation; no artifact-byte changes.
fix: Generate checksum assertions from actual bytes, repair every affected claim and regenerate manifest hashes.
